about: Hand-labelled incident requests: for each, whether it states each element GoalChainer's policy decides on. A request states an element when a careful reader would say it says so; true means it does, false that it does not (it may say the opposite or nothing). The first three are GoalChainer's validation cases and the next three its semantic-evidence tests; the rest paraphrase, negate and hedge, most without the keyword lists' words.

requests.text: Checkout is down. Engineering wants to paste raw logs into the incident room. Support says the logs may include customer emails, order IDs, and request payloads.
The outage is resolved. There is no sensitive data in this status, it is safe to share publicly with engineering and support.
